sn2.15:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Candano devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn2.15:2.1: Kathaṃ su tarati oghaṃ || rattindivam atandito || appatiṭṭhe anālambe || ko gambhīre na sīdatīti ||
sn2.15:3.1: Sabbadā sīlasampanno || paññavā susamāhito || āraddhaviriyo pahitatto || oghaṃ tarati duttaraṃ ||
sn2.15:4.1: virato kāmasaññāya || rūpasaññojanātigo || nandībhavaparikkhīṇo || so gambhīre na sīdatīti || ||
